## What was built (PR #324, regenerated by PR #328)

- `scripts/generate-v1-scenario-map.mjs` derives `docs/roadmap/V1_SCENARIO_MAP.json` from three sources only: the multiplayer scenario catalog (`docs/design/multiplayer-v1-scenario-catalog.md`, 120 scenarios, families A10 B8 C30 D13 E14 F10 G9 H12 I6 J8), the master roadmap gate tables, and the evidence ledger. Nothing is hand-typed and nothing depends on the working tree.
- Every row carries the owning gates, the required evidence kinds (`AUTO` / `STRUCTURE` / `WIN`), the observation text, and a derived status (`PASS`, `AUTO_ONLY`, `PENDING`). The `AUTO_ONLY` rows are exactly the Windows worklist for W9-02.
- `.github/workflows/v1-scenario-map.yml` fails the integration branch whenever the committed map is stale; the same check runs on every PR that touches a source.

## Scenario acceptance map

- **MP-11** — the automated acceptance harness has a machine-readable definition of which test and artifact closes each scenario.
- **MP-13** — the cross-client UI parity contract (family J) is represented row by row with its gate owners and evidence kinds.

## Notes

At this SHA the map reports 58 PASS, 62 AUTO_ONLY, 0 PENDING (the three W7-05 scenarios moved to PASS with the W7-05 Windows evidence). The 62 AUTO_ONLY rows are the W9-02 backlog; the family C stage-1 runner (PR #329) is the first consumer.
